messages:
maya-cs: Heads-up — PelagoRetail kicks off EU pilot tomorrow 09:00 UTC. They need a temporary surge window for demo traffic and a header-based allowlist (partner-facing) so their reverse proxy can call our hosted endpoints. Renewal convo in 2 weeks; if demo fails they’re likely to downgrade.

sam-ops: Got it. What magnitude are we talking for the surge and how long? IPs or header? Any region pinning?

maya-cs: Asking product — they want +3x baseline QPS for 4 hours (09:00–13:00 UTC). Header whitelist: X-Partner-Token with value starting "pelago-". Region: route to eu-west-2 only. Also want fallback to a quantized small model if latency > 400ms.

alex-eng: Can do header allowlist on the gateway side. For routing -> create policy to prefer eu-west-2 then fallback to eu-central if capacity constrained. Small quantized model variant is available: model-id pelago-lite-q4_0. I can wire the fallback policy. Need the exact header pattern + duration + IP CIDR if they prefer both.

maya-cs: Header pattern confirmed: ^pelago-[a-z0-9]{8,12}$. No CIDR. Duration 4 hours then auto-revoke. Please mark renewal-risk = high on the account so AMs know.

sam-ops: Preparing config snippet for infra. Will add auto-revoke and TTL 4h.

sam-ops: ```json
{
  "customer": "pelago-retail",
  "region_policy": {"preferred": ["eu-west-2"], "fallback": ["eu-central-1"]},
  "rate_window": {"multiplier": 3, "window_start": "2026-03-24T09:00:00Z", "duration": "4h"},
  "allowlist": {"header": "X-Partner-Token", "pattern": "^pelago-[a-z0-9]{8,12}$"},
  "fallback_model": "pelago-lite-q4_0",
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```

alex-eng: LGTM. I'll stage the routing + fallback policy and flag the model variant in the catalog. Sam — can you schedule the window and attach the config to the change request?

sam-ops: Change request created: CR-2026-0421-pelago-surge. Pushing to infra now.

infra-bot: Change CR-2026-0421-pelago-surge applied: rate multiplier=3 (eu-west-2 preferred), header allowlist added for X-Partner-Token, fallback model pelago-lite-q4_0 enabled. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-03-24T13:00:00Z.

leo-cs: Noted — I'll update AM dashboard and add a renewal-high tag. Maya, can you capture demo feedback and any errors from Pelago after the window?

maya-cs: Yes — will collect logs, latency samples, and a short customer diary. Will loop back here within 24h post-demo. :crossed_fingers:
